source.name: AIDA Phase 1 Data Freeze v2 (Asian Immune Diversity Atlas), PBMC, 10x 5' v2
source.labels: obs.cell_type (author annotation mapped to Cell Ontology by the submitters; curated, not re-clustered here)

dataset.normalisation: counts -> normalise to 1e4 per cell -> log1p (as PBMC3k .raw)
dataset.split: by donor (GroupShuffleSplit, test_size 0.3 of donors, seed 7)

task.M_rule: start at the grid M one step below the first with predicted rel. error <= 2.5; converged = stream bal.acc >= exact - 0.01 and rel. error < 1; run one grid step beyond; capped by records/seed and time

quantum_sim.note: classical simulation of the oracle sketch (p.sin(c phi)); NOT run on hardware

sample_cost.rule: rel_err(M) = ||phi_M - Delta|| / ||Delta||, mean over seeds; M10 = M with rel_err = 0.1 from the c/sqrt(M) fit
